scope.main_claim_boundary: The determinant invariance component used in Ex160 and the combined Gaussian integral/fixed-known-normalizer context; all of C.4 is inventoried.

source_faithful_contract.setup: Let d≥2 be an integer and κ≥2 real. For i=1,…,d set θ_i=((i−1/2)π)/d, λ_i=(κ+1)/2+((κ−1)/2)cos θ_i, and Λ=diag(λ₁,…,λ_d). For every O∈O(d) set A=OΛOᵀ.
source_faithful_contract.determinant_component: det A=det Λ for every O in full O(d), without restricting its determinant sign.
source_faithful_contract.normalizer_component: For the quadratic V_A(x)=½xᵀAx and target N(0,A^{-1}), Gaussian integration gives Z_A=(2π)^{d/2}(det A)^{-1/2}=(2π)^{d/2}(det Λ)^{-1/2}.
source_faithful_contract.independence_and_known_spectrum: For fixed d,κ, Λ is fixed. Hence Z_A is independent of O; if the spectrum is public it is known.
source_faithful_contract.pointwise_versus_randomized: The hard-family experiment samples O from Haar(O(d)), independently of algorithm randomness. The relevant deterministic identities hold for every O, including both Haar components.
source_faithful_contract.Z_convention_limit: The raw source names Gaussian normalization and states the standard formula but does not separately display the Lebesgue-integral definition. That meaning is source-implicit, and candidate phase must expose its exact definition.
